name: football-stories
description: Narrated football story Shorts: find and verify story ideas with two sources per fact (evidence legwork on a cheaper Sonnet subagent, judgement on the session model), draft a fact-cited script, then hand off to a fresh session; narrate it with a free or paid voice (Gemini TTS free tier, local Kokoro, your own recording), align the words with Whisper, build animated cards from a template library with word-timed captions and optional muted footage clips, or a 3D-animated explainer with Remotion + three.js (storyboard, tightened narration, like & subscribe loop ending), revise from numbered feedback, and report the Claude cost after each step.
